text: dsh-model-show 是面向 DSH Web 的模型选择器界面插件。它接管对话输入框中的模型席位，在当前模型名称前显示配置中的供应商名称，组成“供应商/模型”，并保留已有的思考档位文字。下拉菜单仍按供应商分组并显示原模型名，搜索也继续使用原名称；选择器还会组合 DSH 和其他插件提供的标签装饰。它适合需要在模型较多时辨认当前模型来源的 DSH Web 用户。需要兼容范围内的 DSH，并保持内置模型选择与模型标签插件启用；无需额外密钥或网络服务。

dsh-model-show adds the provider name before the selected model in the DSH Web composer. The dropdown keeps provider groups, plain model names, and native search. It needs compatible DSH and the built-in model-selection and label plugins.
想在模型选择器里同时看出模型属于哪个供应商。
DSH 输入框里只有模型名，怎样辨认它来自哪家？
让 DSH Web 的当前模型标签显示成“供应商/模型”。
模型列表很长时，我想快速确认当前选的是哪家提供的模型。
能不能给对话输入框的模型名称加上供应商前缀？
切换模型时希望保留原来的下拉分组和搜索方式。
I want the composer to show which provider a selected model belongs to.
Can the DSH model label include the provider name without changing the dropdown search?
dsh-model-show 的功能「供应商/模型标签」：在对话输入框的当前模型名称前加上模型所属供应商名称，让触发器显示“供应商/模型”；模型带思考档位时仍显示档位。
dsh-model-show 的功能「保留原生菜单与搜索」：下拉列表继续按供应商分组显示原模型名，搜索匹配模型原名，提供商前缀只用于当前选择器触发器。
dsh-model-show 的功能「组合模型标签装饰」：选择器重用 DSH 的模型标签装饰，并把其他插件注册的装饰一并显示；每个装饰独立挂载并由错误边界隔离。
dsh-model-show 的功能「接管模型席位」：客户端插件接入共享的 modelDirectories 服务，并以低优先级注册对话输入框的模型席位，使自定义触发器使用 DSH 当前会话的模型目录。
dsh-model-show 使用 DSH Web 专用的模型席位；需要兼容范围内的 DSH，并依赖内置模型选择与模型标签插件提供的目录和徽标能力。

dsh-model-show README · Introduction：

dsh-model-show README · dsh-model-show：The composer's model selector in DSH Web shows **Provider/Model** instead of a bare model name, so
the picked model always names the provider it came from — and nothing else about the selector
changes.

| | Composer trigger |
|---|---|
| Before | `Example Chat · High` |
| After | `Example Provider/Example Chat · High` |

*Above: provider `OpenCode Zen`, model `DeepSeek V4.1 Flash`; the trailing `Default` is the
thinking-effort suffix DSH already appends.*

dsh-model-show README · dsh-model-show：- **Only the trigger text changes.** The provider prefix comes from your own model configuration
  (`displayName`) — no hard-coded vendor list.
- **Dropdown and search stay native.** Rows remain plain model names under their provider headings;
  typing a provider name still matches nothing.
- **The built-in release badge survives** (`DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash` → `1017`) and keeps following
  whatever the running DSH build ships.
- **Other plugins decorating the same label are rendered too**, each in its own bounded box behind
  an error boundary (v1.0.4).
- **No settings, no network, no telemetry.** It reads the catalog DSH already has.

dsh-model-show README · Requirements：- DSH `>= 0.2.2-rc.1 < 0.2.3-0`, `web` client platform.
- The built-in model selection plugin (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-model-selection`) must stay
  enabled — this plugin reuses its `modelDirectories` service and only shadows the composer seat.
  The built-in label plugin (`…deepseek-model-label-1017`) must stay enabled too; it draws the badge.
- Provider names are whatever your configuration declares (`displayName`), e.g. `Example Provider`.

dsh-model-show README · Install：**Plugin market** — search the npm package name `dsh-model-show`, install, enable.

**Desktop CLI** (the reserved `desktop` profile is managed only by the app's own CLI):

```console
"%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop add dsh-model-show
```

dsh-model-show README · Install：From GitHub or a local directory, replace the package name with `github:<user>/dsh-model-show` or
`"C:\path\to\dsh-model-show"`. **Update** with an explicit version
(`add dsh-model-show@<version>` — see [releases](https://github.com/ken95573/dsh-model-show/releases); the registry `latest` can lag behind rc builds); **remove** with
`plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-model-show`.

**Let the agent do it** — `plugin_manager`, `action: install_bundle`, `target` = package directory.

dsh-model-show README · In effect / off again：| Action | Effect |
|---|---|
| Install, enable or disable from the plugin UI or market | DSH recomposes the tree in place; with HMR present (the Desktop build ships it) it applies **without a restart** |
| `dsh plugin … add` from a shell, or hand-editing the profile | Disk-level change — restart once |
| Disable the plugin | The slot entry is disposed and the **built-in seat takes over**: the trigger returns to the plain model name, no leftovers |

dsh-model-show README · In effect / off again：If DSH ever answers “restart required” after a UI action, it is one of four documented reasons
(package moved, host module touched, unmanaged plugin, module comparison) — none apply here.

dsh-model-show README · What it does：- **Trigger** — `Example Chat` → `Example Provider/Example Chat` (plus `· High` when the model has a
  thinking effort).
- **Badge** — the built-in decorator matches the model name literally, so the untouched catalog name
  is kept beside the prefixed one and the decorator is replayed with it. The prefix shows once and
  the badge keeps tracking DSH; it is never hard-coded.
- **Menu, search, ARIA** — rows keep the plain name, search matches plain names only, and the ARIA
  label mirrors the visible `Provider/Model` text.

dsh-model-show README · Why it cannot freeze the composer：`conversation.input.model` is a `single` slot: exactly one entry renders, and this plugin registers
at `priority: -1` so it shadows the built-in seat. DSH only injects a `renderSlot` face into entries
that declare children, and the child label slot may be declared only once (by the built-in seat) —
so the plugin composes that child slot itself:

text:
dsh-model-show README · FAQ：**Menu rows don't show the provider — a bug?** No. Only the trigger is rewritten, so grouping and
search stay predictable.

**Badge gone?** Enable the built-in `…deepseek-model-label-1017` plugin; the badge is a replayed
decorator, not a string this plugin prints.

**Market card says host requirement unknown?** The curated catalog fills its `npm` field from the
registry on its own schedule; once it has, the card shows the version and `engines.dsh` and installs
from the registry.

dsh-model-show README · FAQ：**Installed but nothing changed?** Check the built-in model selection plugin is enabled and that the
profile's `dsh.profile.bundles` still lists `dsh-model-show` (a broken declaration can be dropped
during a host upgrade) — re-add the row and restart.

dsh-model-show README · Privacy：No network requests, no telemetry. It reads only what DSH exposes (the session's model catalog, the
locale dictionaries, the slot registry) and never writes your catalog, credentials or settings. The
published package is 12 files: code, locales, icon, screenshot, patch, licence/notice, readmes.

dsh-model-show README · Development：```console
npm test              # manifest, vendoring edits, label composition, package whitelist
npm run vendor        # re-extract the built-in bundle and re-apply the edits
npm run vendor:check  # non-zero exit when the shipped bundle drifts
```

dsh-model-show README · Development：`npm run vendor` reads `…\resources\app\dsh\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-client-ui-model-selection\lib\client.js`
from the installed app (newer builds ship unpacked, so `--from <client.js>` and `--asar <app.asar>`
are both accepted). If upstream moves an anchor it fails loudly instead of emitting a broken bundle.
`lib/client.js` is compared byte-for-byte and normalised to LF, so a CRLF checkout breaks both
`npm test` and `vendor:check`.

dsh-model-show README · Development：| Path | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `lib/client.js` | vendored browser bundle (11 documented edits) |
| `lib/index.js`, `cordis.patch.yml` | host half (empty `apply`) and the row that mounts it |
| `scripts/vendor-from-asar.mjs` | extract, edit, verify |
| `tests/*.test.mjs` | bundle assertions, label composition, publish whitelist |

dsh-model-show README · Known limitations：- `lib/client.js` is a vendored copy of the built-in bundle, so it still relies on the browser module
  table's `dsh-client-ui-primitives`, `cordis` and `dsh-client-store` (declared in
  `dsh.client.external`). A future refactor of the built-in selector can invalidate it; `engines.dsh`,
  the vendoring script and the test suite are the three guards.
- The control reuses the built-in implementation, including its `min(360px, 45cqw)` trigger width: a
  long `Provider/Model` is ellipsised, never wrapped.
- The vendored bundle keeps the built-in plugin's full service list on purpose — the seat resolves
  its catalog through the consuming context, and trimming the list makes the first render after
  launch throw and the seat silently retire.
- No settings: the format is fixed as `Provider/Model`.
- Third-party decorations also render in the dropdown rows, which can look noisy in a long list.

dsh-model-show README · License：MIT. `lib/client.js` derives from `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-model-selection` (MIT, Copyright (c)
DeepSeek); see [NOTICE.md](https://github.com/ken95573/dsh-model-show/blob/main/NOTICE.md).

dsh-model-show README · Introduction：

dsh-model-show README · dsh-model-show：DSH Web 的对话框模型选择器显示为 **供应商/模型**，而不是一个光秃秃的模型名——选中的模型一眼看出属于哪个供应商，而选择器的其它部分一概不动。

| | 输入框右下角的触发器 |
|---|---|
| 之前 | `Example Chat · High` |
| 之后 | `Example Provider/Example Chat · High` |

*上图：供应商 `OpenCode Zen`、模型 `DeepSeek V4.1 Flash`，末尾的 `Default` 是 DSH 原本就会带的思考档位后缀。*

dsh-model-show README · dsh-model-show：- **只改触发器上的文字。** 供应商前缀取自你自己的模型配置（`displayName`），插件里没有硬编码的厂商名单。
- **下拉菜单与搜索保持原生。** 每一行仍是纯模型名、仍按供应商分组；输入供应商名依旧匹配不到模型。
- **内置的版本徽标不会丢**（`DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash` → `1017`），并且跟着当前 DSH 版本走。
- **别的插件往同一标签上加的装饰也会显示**，每块各自有错误边界与有界盒子（v1.0.4）。
- **无配置、无网络、无遥测。** 只读 DSH 本来就已经拿到的模型目录。

dsh-model-show README · 环境要求：- DSH `>= 0.2.2-rc.1 < 0.2.3-0`，`web` 客户端平台。
- 内置模型选择插件（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-model-selection`）**必须保持启用**：本插件复用它提供的 `modelDirectories` 服务，只接管输入框那个座位。内置版本标签插件（`…deepseek-model-label-1017`）也要启用——徽标由它画出来。
- 供应商名字取自你自己模型配置里的 `displayName`（例如 `Example Provider`）。

dsh-model-show README · 安装：**插件市场** — 搜索包名 `dsh-model-show`，安装后启用。

**桌面端自带 CLI**（保留的 `desktop` profile 只能由应用自带 CLI 管理）：

```console
"%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop add dsh-model-show
```

dsh-model-show README · 安装：从 GitHub 或本地目录安装，把包名换成 `github:<用户名>/dsh-model-show` 或 `"C:\path\to\dsh-model-show"`。**更新**请写显式版本（`add dsh-model-show@<目标版本>`，版本号见 [Releases](https://github.com/ken95573/dsh-model-show/releases)；仓库的 `latest` 可能落后于 rc 版本）；**卸载**用 `plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-model-show`。

**让 agent 装** — `plugin_manager`，`action: install_bundle`，`target` 传包目录。

dsh-model-show README · 生效与停用：| 操作 | 行为 |
|---|---|
| 从插件 UI 或市场安装、启用、停用 | DSH 当场重排插件树；本机具备 HMR（桌面端自带）时**无需重启**即生效 |
| 命令行 `dsh plugin … add`，或手改 profile | 属磁盘级改动，重启一次确认 |
| 停用插件 | 槽位条目被释放，**内置座位自动接管**：触发器回到纯模型名，无任何残留 |

如果 DSH 在 UI 操作后提示「请重启」，只会是四种已文档化的原因之一（包目录变了、触及宿主模块、涉及不受管理的插件、无法比对磁盘文件）——本插件都不涉及。

dsh-model-show README · 它做了什么：- **触发器** —— `Example Chat` → `Example Provider/Example Chat`（模型带思考档位时再跟 `· High`）。
- **徽标** —— 内置装饰器按模型名**字面匹配**，所以插件把未经改动的目录原名留在旁边、用它去重放装饰器。前缀只出现一次，徽标始终跟随 DSH 发布的内容，从不硬编码。
- **菜单、搜索、无障碍** —— 菜单行保持纯模型名，搜索只匹配纯模型名，`aria-label` 与悬停提示和可见文字一致。

dsh-model-show README · 为什么不会拖垮输入框：`conversation.input.model` 是 `single` 槽位：只渲染一个条目，本插件注册在 `priority: -1`，因此遮蔽内置座位。DSH 只给**声明了 children** 的条目注入 `renderSlot`，而子槽位只能被声明一次（被内置座位占用），所以这个子槽位由插件自己组合：

- 每个注册都以组件方式**挂载**（`createElement`），别的插件的 hook 组件保有自己的 hook 槽；
- 每块都套**错误边界**——第三方装饰器渲染期抛错只会让那一块变空白（以前正是这种错误让菜单卡死、日志里什么都没有）；
- 每块都在**有界盒子**里（`min-width: 0`、`max-width: 100%`、`overflow: hidden`、省略号），自带背景或宽度上限的整块 pill 也撑不破触发器；
- **标签主体固定为 DSH 自己的装饰器**（locale 前缀 `deepseek-model-label`），其余注册追加在旁边，而不是被丢弃。
section: 为什么不会拖垮输入框

text: dsh-model-show README · 为什么不会拖垮输入框：副作用：这些附加装饰也会出现在下拉菜单的每一行——平台对每一行同样渲染那个槽位。
section: 为什么不会拖垮输入框

text:
dsh-model-show README · 常见问题：**菜单里不显示供应商，是 bug 吗？** 不是。只改写触发器，菜单行保持纯模型名，分组与搜索才可预期。

**徽标不见了？** 启用内置的 `…deepseek-model-label-1017` 插件——徽标是重放它的装饰器，不是本插件打印的字符串。

**市场卡片显示「宿主要求未知」？** 市场目录会自行从 registry 推导 `npm` 字段；推导完成后卡片显示版本与 `engines.dsh`，安装也改走 registry。

**装了没反应？** 确认内置模型选择插件处于启用状态，并确认 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里还列着 `dsh-model-show`（宿主升级时损坏的声明可能被丢掉）——补回该行并重启。
dsh-model-show README · 隐私：不发网络请求、无遥测。只读 DSH 已经暴露的接口（当前会话的模型目录、语言词典、槽位注册表），运行时不写你的模型目录、凭据或设置。发布包共 12 个文件：代码、语言包、图标、截图、patch、许可与说明、两份 README。

dsh-model-show README · 开发：```console
npm test              # manifest、vendoring 改动、标签组合行为、发布白名单
npm run vendor        # 重新提取内置 bundle 并重新打改动
npm run vendor:check  # 已发布的 bundle 与重新提取结果不一致时以非零码退出
```

`npm run vendor` 读取已安装应用里的 `…\resources\app\dsh\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-client-ui-model-selection\lib\client.js`（新版安装包已解包，因此同时支持 `--from <client.js>` 与 `--asar <app.asar>`）。上游挪动锚点时脚本会直接报错退出，不会产出坏包。`lib/client.js` 按字节比较且行尾统一为 LF，CRLF 检出会让 `npm test` 与 `vendor:check` 双双失败。

dsh-model-show README · 开发：| 路径 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `lib/client.js` | vendored 浏览器 bundle（11 处有据可查的改动） |
| `lib/index.js`、`cordis.patch.yml` | 宿主半段（空 `apply`）与挂载它的那一行 |
| `scripts/vendor-from-asar.mjs` | 提取、改动、校验 |
| `tests/*.test.mjs` | bundle 断言、标签组合、发布白名单 |

dsh-model-show README · 已知限制：- `lib/client.js` 是内置 bundle 的 vendored 副本，仍依赖浏览器模块表里的 `dsh-client-ui-primitives`、`cordis`、`dsh-client-store`（已在 `dsh.client.external` 声明）。未来若 DSH 重构内置选择器，这份副本可能失效；`engines.dsh`、vendoring 脚本与测试套件是三道保险。
- 控件沿用内置实现，包括 `min(360px, 45cqw)` 的触发器宽度：过长的「供应商/模型」会被省略号截断，不会换行。
- vendored bundle 刻意保留内置插件的完整服务列表——座位通过消费方上下文解析模型目录，裁掉列表会让启动后第一次渲染抛错、座位被静默除名。
- 没有可配置项：格式固定为「供应商/模型」。
- 同一标签上的第三方装饰也会在菜单每一行渲染，长列表里可能显得嘈杂。

dsh-model-show README · 许可：MIT。`lib/client.js` 派生自 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-model-selection`（MIT，Copyright (c) DeepSeek），详见 [NOTICE.md](https://github.com/ken95573/dsh-model-show/blob/main/NOTICE.md)。
